neighbours.label: the word 'instead'
fire: The original recipe called for brandy instead of whisky in the cocktail.
He never became a doctor and instead spent his life painting the coast.
We took the train instead of driving because of the snow.
She decided to stay home and read instead of going to the party.
Use honey instead of sugar if you want a softer flavour.
The council voted to repair the old bridge instead of building a new one.
Many students now type their notes instead of writing them by hand.
The band skipped the tour and instead recorded a second album.
